basis_words: Window: start 2026-10-01 and end 2026-10-13, as the order names. Household: the lowest-sha256 household with two or more accounts in the private account dimension (221 such households were eligible); its Orion household id is the dimension household_id as an integer, the rule orion_account_mapping.py applies, and the vendor account id is the first account in sorted order. Response shape: none. Both calls returned HTTP 400, a non-2xx, so no body was saved and no node types can be named. The one-account limit is the estate's code, not the vendor's: orion_account_mapping.py refuses any household holding other than one account, and this household holds several, so the estate's own mapping would refuse it; the vendor's own limit is not measured. The two POSTs sent the dict requests_for returns, which wraps the scope under a scope key; calculate() in orion_selected.py posts the inner scope, so this probe did not send the estate's live shape and its 400 answers are unread. Credential: the session token was read once from the estate's Secrets Manager secret with no refusal, and no 401 or 403 came back. Fee basis: not measured, since no flag-false success exists to compare against. Pace: the second call was made six seconds after the first, and no call was retried because a 4xx is not retried. Two of four calls were used; no further call was made.
